accepted_causal_chain: Rerun141 is an exact-current-identity, exact-party, MaxActiveCohorts=1 immutable canary with a complete strict 14-node route, four real boss deaths, complete cleanup, verified publication, and no forbidden assistance.
The strict failures reproduce exactly as 2800/3145 all-hostile retention, 235/3145 healer exposure, and 5610 ms maximum per-hostile dwell.
Generation 13 contributes 222 of 235 healer samples; removing generation 13 would pass both aggregate ratio gates, while generation 14 would still fail the dwell ceiling at 3579 ms.

The two over-limit windows are not the aggregate ratio cause: removing both leaves worse 2044/2330 retention and 176/2330 exposure. Five eligible short/long generation-13 wave groups account for all 222 generation-13 healer samples.

The dominant 132-sample wave and a second 24-sample wave each show full large-wave tank ownership followed by one nearest-target generic decision and then a mass healer flip. A policy snapshot proves the old nearest target blocked Thrash solely through its owned aura while other area tools were on native cooldown.

Rerun141 reactive densest-healer targeting successfully converged exposed waves, but it starts after pending healing threat has already flipped eligible identities. The missing behavior is proactive densest tank-owned cluster selection while a large Feral wave is currently owned.
The independent generation-14 residual missed dwell by 579 ms after exact-anchor boss handoff travel; the ordinary-trash path already proves a collision-safe eight-yard native-Roar intercept.

The smallest evidence-supported correction is therefore two bounded target/movement changes: extend the current Feral ten-yard density selector to large currently tank-owned trash waves before generic area resolution, and use the same collision-safe eight-yard intercept for boss post-Roar remote-cluster movement. Native cooldowns, victims, threat values, and all acceptance gates remain unchanged.

changes.change: Retain current tank-owned trash targets. When the Feral tank owns at least 90 percent of a 12-or-more-hostile ordinary-trash wave, deterministically rebind the generic area target to the largest current ten-yard tank-owned cluster before the existing area resolver; prefer a target missing this Feral's Thrash aura, then tie-break by cluster size, distance, and GUID. This is a target-only extension of the rerun141 selector and leaves all spell legality, cooldown, GCD, victim, and threat operations native.
changes.expected_effect: A fresh dense cluster can keep Thrash/Swipe legal or receive proactive movement before pending healing threat flips already-eligible identities; the existing reactive healer selector remains authoritative after any flip.

changes.change: For the existing identity-bound Feral boss remote-cluster handoff, move to the remote anchor's collision-safe eight-yard native-Roar intercept instead of the hostile exact point, preserving the same anchor, path validation, reservation, cooldowns, and arrival gates.
changes.expected_effect: Remove only avoidable exact-anchor travel from the 3579-ms generation-14 residual while preserving the proven bounded handoff contract.
